talents.name: Field Fix
talents.description: Make a Mechanics check to repair a physically accessible device, drone, or structure. On a success, restore 1d6 + 2 HP, up to its maximum HP. This does not remove malfunctions or restore a destroyed system.

talents.name: Quick Bypass
talents.description: Make a Security Systems check to pick a nonmagical lock or disable a nonmagical alarm as a Maneuver instead of an Action. Use the task’s normal difficulty, access, and equipment requirements. This Talent cannot affect warded, magical, or Hardened systems.

talents.name: Breachfinder’s Eye
talents.description: Examine a device, machine, or structure within Short range and make a Mechanics or Demolitions check to identify a physical weak point. On a success, your next attack or sabotage attempt against that examined target before the end of your next turn gains +1 Bonus Die. Choose one additional benefit when identifying the weak point: the attack deals +1d4 damage (P) on a hit, or a successful attack or sabotage attempt imposes 1 Penalty Die on that target’s next Action roll before the end of its next turn. Examining equipment does not grant these benefits against its wearer or operator.

talents.name: Rapid Jury-Rig

talents.name: Improvised Expertise

talents.name: Precision Override

Choose its effect when you install it: the first person who tampers with the object takes 1d6 damage (P), or the object shuts down when first tampered with and remains disabled until the end of the following round. The countermeasure is expended when triggered.

If you win, the drone takes no hostile actions until the start of your next turn. If your winning result is a Hard Success or better, it also follows one simple command during that time, using its normal action allowance.

talents.cost: None initially; 1 Strain per additional round

Controlled devices retain their normal functions and action allowances.

A trapped target or an ally who can reach it may spend an Action and succeed on an appropriate Athletics or Mechanics check to free it.

talents.name: Field Constructor
talents.description:
Using available parts and tools, make a Mechanics check to construct one turret, barricade, or utility drone within Engaged range. On a success, deploy it using the profile below. It becomes nonfunctional when the Scene ends.

Construction: Turret: Remote Sentry Pod; HP: 14; Physical/Veil Soak: 3/0; SR: 50; Power: Industrial P-CELL; Function: Stationary, approximately 18 kg. Fixed mount for one supplied handgun or SMG. Use your appropriate Firearms Skill and the weapon’s normal range, damage, ammunition, and Traits. Can monitor an approach and send movement alerts.
Construction: Barricade: Rapid-Cover Barrier; HP: 20; Physical/Veil Soak: 5/0; SR: None; Power: None; Function: Approximately 15 kg. Cover for one or two characters according to position: Partial Cover imposes 1 Penalty Die on incoming attacks; Full Cover requires completely blocking line of sight. Provides no special protection against effects that bypass physical cover.
Construction: Utility drone: Utility Crawler; HP: 10; Physical/Veil Soak: 1/0; SR: 40; Power: Standard P-CELL; Function: Ground crawler; DEX 55, SIZ 25; carries approximately 10 kg. Optics and a manipulator for ordinary doors, accessible controls, small objects, cables, and equipment placement. Cannot fly or make attacks.

The turret and crawler are Command-Linked to a paired Omni or other suitable controller within Medium range. On your turn, spend your Action to direct one construction’s attack, complex task, or Skill roll, using your appropriate Skill. Each can perform at most one directed Action per Round. The crawler may also take one normal ground Move Maneuver per Round. Routine following, holding position, or movement alerts need no additional Action. They have no independent turns and cannot take Reactions. If the link is lost, it stops safely and holds position.

Neither machine is Hardened. At 0 HP they become Disabled; use the normal machine damage rules and 40% for any structural Integrity Check. They have no Strain pool and are immune to Stun or other Strain damage; machine-specific effects still apply.

Supply the required charged P-CELL and any firearm and ammunition yourself. Use their normal ammunition and power rules. Successful construction replaces ordinary deployment time. These temporary constructions have only the listed features and cannot receive additional Platform Mods.

Any remaining catastrophic outcome becomes a delayed hazard that occurs at the end of the next round instead of immediately.

Reduce one Physical or Veil damage amount by 2d6 after Soak and other reductions, to a minimum of 0. This does not stack with other magical damage reductions; use the highest. It cannot directly protect living creatures or implanted cyberware.

talents.name: Overcode Detonation

Shutdown prevents powered functions, communications, Actions, Maneuvers, and Reactions; passive armor remains. At the end of each of its turns, a shut-down target repeats its Security Rating resistance against your original casting, rebooting if it matches or exceeds your original Success Tier. This requires no Action. Devices without turns attempt to reboot at the end of your turns, beginning with your next turn. Crewed vehicles and manually operated equipment are ineligible.

Control ends on successful resistance or if it moves beyond Medium range. It cannot receive another activation in the same round.

This does not affect area attacks or attacks made with implanted weapons.

talents.name: Disrupting Blow

talents.description_markdown: Before a damaging attack with your **Bound Focus**, gather a pulse of force behind the impact. If it deals at least **1 HP** damage, the target becomes **Shaken** **until the end of its next turn**. The attack retains its normal damage type.

prerequisites.text: False Edge or Veil Temper (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Reaching Arc
talents.description: Project your weapon’s movement into one attack against a target within Short range. You must perceive it and have an unobstructed path. Use normal weapon damage and Damage Bonus. The target may Dodge, but may Fight Back only if it can reach you. You may Infuse the attack at its normal cost. This does not move you or extend your reach for other attacks.
talents.description_markdown: Project your weapon’s movement into one attack against a target within **Short range**. You must perceive it and have an unobstructed path. Use normal weapon damage and **Damage Bonus**. The target may **Dodge**, but may **Fight Back** only if it can reach you. You may Infuse the attack at its normal cost. This does not move you or extend your reach for other attacks.

prerequisites.text: Veil Temper or Weapon Recall (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Reversing Current
talents.description: When you win a Fight Back with your Bound Focus, you may forgo its damage to knock the attacker up to Short range away from you. Their Build cannot exceed yours by more than 1. They stop early if they strike a solid obstacle. This can send them over an edge or into a hazard; resolve any collision, falling, or environmental effects normally. The knockback itself does not cause Prone. Any Strain already spent enhancing the attack remains spent. You may use this when its trigger occurs outside your turn; it costs no Reaction beyond the Fight Back.
talents.description_markdown: When you win a **Fight Back** with your **Bound Focus**, you may forgo its damage to knock the attacker up to **Short range** away from you. Their Build cannot exceed yours by more than 1. They stop early if they strike a solid obstacle. This can send them over an edge or into a hazard; resolve any collision, falling, or environmental effects normally. The knockback itself does not cause **Prone**. Any Strain already spent enhancing the attack remains spent. You may use this when its trigger occurs outside your turn; it costs no Reaction beyond the **Fight Back**.

prerequisites.text: Close-In Guard or Slipstream Cut (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Shared Guard
talents.description: When an ally Engaged with you attempts to Dodge an attack you can perceive, extend a spectral guard from your Bound Focus to grant one Bonus Die on that Dodge roll.
talents.description_markdown: When an ally Engaged with you attempts to **Dodge** an attack you can perceive, extend a spectral guard from your **Bound Focus** to grant **one Bonus Die** on that **Dodge** roll.

talents.name: Binding Cut
talents.description: Declare a Disarm or Knockdown, then make one damaging attack with your Bound Focus, applying the technique’s normal Build limits and Penalty Dice. On a hit, deal normal damage and apply the technique, even if Soak prevents all damage. The target may Dodge or Fight Back normally.
talents.description_markdown: Declare a Disarm or Knockdown, then make one damaging attack with your **Bound Focus**, applying the technique’s normal Build limits and Penalty Dice. On a hit, deal normal damage and apply the technique, even if Soak prevents all damage. The target may **Dodge** or **Fight Back** normally.

prerequisites.text: Disrupting Blow or Reversing Current (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Charged Temper
talents.description: When using Veil Temper, you may pay 3 Strain instead of 1 to add +1d6 damage instead of +1. This remains one [Infuse] effect.
talents.description_markdown: When using **Veil Temper**, you may pay **3 Strain** instead of 1 to add **+1d6 damage** instead of +1. This remains one **[Infuse]** effect.

prerequisites.text: Breaching Temper or Disrupting Blow (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Echoing Cut
talents.description: After your Bound Focus hits on your turn, make one additional attack against a different target within your normal melee reach as a spectral repetition of the strike. Use normal weapon damage and Damage Bonus, all treated as Veil damage. Resolve defenses and critical hits normally. This attack cannot receive an Infuse or Form effect. It uses your shared follow-up allowance and cannot generate another attack.
talents.description_markdown: After your **Bound Focus** hits on your turn, make one additional attack against a different target within your normal melee reach as a spectral repetition of the strike. Use normal weapon damage and **Damage Bonus**, all treated as Veil damage. Resolve defenses and critical hits normally. This attack cannot receive an Infuse or Form effect. It uses your shared **follow-up allowance** and cannot generate another attack.

talents.name: Folded Assault
talents.description: Teleport to an unoccupied supporting surface you can see within Short range, then make one attack with your Bound Focus against a target within reach. The teleport requires no Maneuver or Disengage cost and can escape a physical Grapple. Worn restraints travel with you; effects preventing teleportation still apply. You may enhance the attack normally.
talents.description_markdown: Teleport to an unoccupied supporting surface you can see within **Short range**, then make one attack with your **Bound Focus** against a target within reach. The teleport requires no Maneuver or Disengage cost and can escape a physical Grapple. Worn restraints travel with you; effects preventing teleportation still apply. You may enhance the attack normally.

prerequisites.text: Reaching Arc or Reversing Current (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Interceding Blade
talents.description: When an opponent within your normal melee reach makes a melee attack against an ally Engaged with you, Fight Back against that attack using your Bound Focus as though you were its target. Declare before either side rolls. Your ally makes no defense roll against that attack. If you win, prevent the attack and deal normal Fight Back damage; if the attacker wins, its attack hits the ally. Tied successful tiers favor the attacker. If both fail, neither hits. This costs a separate Reaction and does not establish or use your defensive commitment.
talents.description_markdown: When an opponent within your normal melee reach makes a melee attack against an ally Engaged with you, **Fight Back** against that attack using your **Bound Focus** as though you were its target. Declare before either side rolls. Your ally makes no defense roll against that attack. If you win, prevent the attack and deal normal **Fight Back** damage; if the attacker wins, its attack hits the ally. Tied successful tiers favor the attacker. If both fail, neither hits. This costs a separate Reaction and does not establish or use your defensive commitment.

talents.name: Dancing Weapon
talents.description: For the rest of the Scene, your Bound Focus can hover under your control within Short range of you. Once on each of your turns, move it along an unobstructed route to a point you can see within that range, or return it to your empty hand, without spending a Maneuver. You may spend your Action to make one attack from its position using Melee Weapons, normal weapon damage, and Damage Bonus. You must perceive the target, which may Dodge normally and may Fight Back only if it can reach you. You may Infuse the attack, but cannot apply a Form or perform a Combat Technique through it. The weapon grants no engagement, independent actions, or remote defenses. It falls when the effect ends unless held or supported.
talents.description_markdown: For the rest of the Scene, your **Bound Focus** can hover under your control within **Short range** of you. Once on each of your turns, move it along an unobstructed route to a point you can see within that range, or return it to your empty hand, without spending a Maneuver. You may spend your Action to make one attack from its position using **Melee Weapons**, normal weapon damage, and **Damage Bonus**. It falls when the effect ends unless held or supported.

talents.name: Guardian’s Reach
talents.description: For the rest of the Scene, once per Round you may use Close-In Guard, Shared Guard, or Interceding Blade without its Strain cost or Scene-use expenditure. Each still costs a Reaction. Shared Guard can protect an ally within Short range. Interceding Blade can protect an ally within Short range against a melee attacker also within Short range of you, projecting your Fight Back through your Bound Focus. You must perceive the attack.
talents.description_markdown: For the rest of the Scene, once per Round you may use **Close-In Guard**, **Shared Guard**, or **Interceding Blade** without its Strain cost or Scene-use expenditure. Each still costs a Reaction. **Shared Guard** can protect an ally within **Short range**. **Interceding Blade** can protect an ally within **Short range** against a melee attacker also within **Short range** of you, projecting your **Fight Back** through your **Bound Focus**. You must perceive the attack.

talents.name: Phantom Flurry
talents.description: Your shared follow-up allowance must be available to use this Action. Make two attacks against the same target within reach: one with your Bound Focus and one with its spectral duplicate. Both use your Bound Focus’s normal attack and damage rules. Each gains one Bonus Die, AP 3, and your choice of Physical or Veil damage. Resolve each attack and defense separately. A successful Fight Back against either attack deals its damage to you. The second attack uses your shared follow-up allowance. Neither attack can receive another Infuse or Form effect or generate further attacks.
talents.description_markdown: Your shared **follow-up allowance** must be available to use this Action. Make two attacks against the same target within reach: one with your **Bound Focus** and one with its spectral duplicate. Both use your **Bound Focus**’s normal attack and damage rules. Each gains **one Bonus Die**, **AP 3**, and your choice of Physical or Veil damage. Resolve each attack and defense separately. A successful **Fight Back** against either attack deals its damage to you. The second attack uses your shared **follow-up allowance**. Neither attack can receive another Infuse or Form effect or generate further attacks.

prerequisites.text: Charged Temper or Echoing Cut (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Unbroken Binding
talents.description: For the rest of the Scene, you may use Binding Cut once on each of your turns without its Strain cost or Scene-use expenditure. Each use still costs an Action and occupies its [Infuse] slot. Treat your Build as 2 higher for those Disarm and Knockdown attempts.
talents.description_markdown: For the rest of the Scene, you may use **Binding Cut** once on each of your turns without its Strain cost or Scene-use expenditure. Each use still costs an Action and occupies its **[Infuse]** slot. Treat your Build as 2 higher for those Disarm and Knockdown attempts.

talents.name: Weave the Battlefield
talents.description: Make up to three attacks with your Bound Focus against different targets, each dealing Veil damage. Between two attacks, teleport once to an unoccupied supporting surface you can see within Short range, without spending a Maneuver or paying a Disengage cost. Each target must be within reach when attacked. Your shared follow-up allowance must be available; this talent spends it and explicitly permits two additional attacks. These attacks cannot receive another Infuse or Form effect or generate further attacks. Normal defenses and critical-hit rules apply.
talents.description_markdown: Make up to three attacks with your **Bound Focus** against different targets, each dealing Veil damage. Between two attacks, teleport once to an unoccupied supporting surface you can see within **Short range**, without spending a Maneuver or paying a Disengage cost. Each target must be within reach when attacked. Your shared **follow-up allowance** must be available; this talent spends it and explicitly permits two additional attacks. These attacks cannot receive another Infuse or Form effect or generate further attacks. Normal defenses and critical-hit rules apply.

prerequisites.text: Echoing Cut or Folded Assault (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Bonded Construct
talents.description: Bind a willing spirit into a Utility, Combat, or Protection frame, creating your personal construct. Use the corresponding companion profile. Its identity and bond persist when you rebuild its body or change its frame. You may have only one personal construct at a time.

Its identity and bond persist when you rebuild its body or change its frame. You may have only one personal construct at a time.

talents.name: Brace the Frame
talents.description: When your personal construct or Workshop Wisp within Short range takes damage from an attack you perceive, reinforce its body. Reduce the attack’s Physical or Veil damage by 1d6 after Soak, to a minimum of 0.
talents.description_markdown: When your personal construct or **Workshop Wisp** within **Short range** takes damage from an attack you perceive, reinforce its body. Reduce the attack’s Physical or Veil damage by **1d6** after Soak, to a minimum of 0.

talents.name: Resonant Patch
talents.description: Touch a willing or authorized construct, bot, drone, or vehicle with at least 1 HP, and make an Archanotech or Mechanics roll. On a success, restore 1d6 + 2 HP, up to its maximum. This repair requires no materials. It cannot restart a Disabled target or replace missing components. A failed roll still expends the Strain and use.
talents.description_markdown: Touch a willing or authorized construct, bot, drone, or vehicle with at least **1 HP**, and make an **Archanotech** or **Mechanics** roll. On a success, restore **1d6 + 2 HP**, up to its maximum. This repair requires no materials. It cannot restart a **Disabled** target or replace missing components. A failed roll still expends the Strain and use.

talents.name: Wake the Mechanism
talents.description: Touch an intact device you are authorized to operate and supply supernatural power for one simple, nonattack function, such as opening a powered door, taking an elevator between floors, or obtaining a sensor reading. If the mechanism’s condition makes operation uncertain, make an Archanotech or Mechanics roll. This supplies power; it does not bypass security, physical obstructions, or missing components, and cannot grant a platform a combat Action.

If the mechanism’s condition makes operation uncertain, make an **Archanotech** or **Mechanics** roll. This supplies power; it does not bypass security, physical obstructions, or missing components, and cannot grant a platform a combat Action.

talents.name: Workshop Wisp
talents.description: Bind a willing spirit into a small physical helper using the Workshop Wisp profile. It can carry small objects, use its tools, perform suitable technical tasks, and Assist with repairs and crafting. You may have one Workshop Wisp in addition to your personal construct.
talents.description_markdown: Bind a willing spirit into a small physical helper using the **Workshop Wisp** profile. It can carry small objects, use its tools, perform suitable technical tasks, and Assist with repairs and crafting. You may have one **Workshop Wisp** in addition to your personal construct.

talents.name: Borrowed Hands
talents.description: Your Workshop Wisp can deliver Resonant Patch, Wake the Mechanism, or Emergency Restart if you have purchased that talent by touching the target while within Medium range of you. You spend the talent’s Action, pay its costs, and make any required roll. This also uses the Wisp’s Action for the Round, but requires no command Maneuver. The Wisp must reach the target through its normal movement.
talents.description_markdown: Your **Workshop Wisp** can deliver **Resonant Patch**, **Wake the Mechanism**, or **Emergency Restart** if you have purchased that talent by touching the target while within **Medium range** of you. You spend the talent’s Action, pay its costs, and make any required roll. This also uses the Wisp’s Action for the Round, but requires no command Maneuver. The Wisp must reach the target through its normal movement.

prerequisites.text: Workshop Wisp and Resonant Patch (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Crew Signals
talents.description: Command both your personal construct and Workshop Wisp with the same Maneuver. Each may take one Action, provided it has not already used its Action that Round. The Wisp remains limited to its normal noncombat capabilities.
talents.description_markdown: Command both your personal construct and **Workshop Wisp** with the same Maneuver. Each may take one Action, provided it has not already used its Action that Round. The Wisp remains limited to its normal noncombat capabilities.

prerequisites.text: Bonded Construct and Workshop Wisp (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Emergency Restart
talents.description: Touch a Disabled but repairable construct, bot, drone, or vehicle and succeed on a Hard Archanotech or Mechanics roll to restore 1d6 + 2 HP and restart it. This requires no repair materials and grants no immediate Action. It cannot restore a catastrophically destroyed body or replace a missing core, power supply, or component. A failed roll still expends the Strain and use.
talents.description_markdown: Touch a **Disabled** but repairable construct, bot, drone, or vehicle and succeed on a Hard **Archanotech** or **Mechanics** roll to restore **1d6 + 2 HP** and restart it. This requires no repair materials and grants no immediate Action. It cannot restore a catastrophically destroyed body or replace a missing core, power supply, or component. A failed roll still expends the Strain and use.

talents.name: Resonant Armament
talents.description: Infuse your personal construct’s weapons while it is within Short range. For the rest of the Scene, it may choose to deal its normal damage type or Veil damage with each attack. Its attacks can affect manifested incorporeal targets it perceives, but cannot strike unmanifested spirits. Weapons retain their normal ammunition and power requirements.
talents.description_markdown: Infuse your personal construct’s weapons while it is within **Short range**. For the rest of the Scene, it may choose to deal its normal damage type or Veil damage with each attack. Its attacks can affect manifested incorporeal targets it perceives, but cannot strike unmanifested spirits. Weapons retain their normal ammunition and power requirements.

talents.name: Second Current
talents.description: Sustain your personal construct or Workshop Wisp within Short range with supernatural power for the rest of the Scene. It can operate without a working power supply. Once during this duration, an effect that would shut it down through EMP or power loss instead makes it Impaired until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent damage, hostile control, or becoming Disabled at 0 HP. Weapons still require their own ammunition and power.
talents.description_markdown: Sustain your personal construct or **Workshop Wisp** within **Short range** with supernatural power **for the rest of the Scene**. It can operate without a working power supply. Once during this duration, an effect that would shut it down through EMP or power loss instead makes it Impaired **until the end of its next turn**. This does not prevent damage, hostile control, or becoming **Disabled** at **0 HP**. Weapons still require their own ammunition and power.

prerequisites.text: Wake the Mechanism or Brace the Frame (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Battlefield Reclamation
talents.description: Animate an unoccupied, uncontrolled wreck or collection of suitable mechanical parts within Short range as a Reclaimed Frame for the rest of the Scene. The parts must support a human-sized frame. Use the Reclaimed Frame profile in this career’s rules. It follows your normal companion command rules and counts toward your limit of one commanded combat companion per Round. It gains none of the wreck’s former weapons, data, or system access. At 0 HP or when the effect ends, its animation ends and the parts become inert.

talents.name: Instinctive Partnership
talents.description: Command your personal construct or Workshop Wisp as a Free Action instead of a Maneuver. This does not increase the number of Actions either companion can take in a Round.
talents.description_markdown: Command your personal construct or **Workshop Wisp** as a Free Action instead of a Maneuver. This does not increase the number of Actions either companion can take in a Round.

prerequisites.text: Crew Signals or Resonant Armament (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Linked Restoration
talents.description: When you use Resonant Patch, extend it to a second eligible target you perceive within Short range of the first. Make one Archanotech or Mechanics roll for both targets and roll the HP restored separately. This expends Resonant Patch’s Scene use for each target. You must touch the first target normally or through Borrowed Hands.
talents.description_markdown: When you use **Resonant Patch**, extend it to a second eligible target you perceive within **Short range** of the first. Make one **Archanotech** or **Mechanics** roll for both targets and roll the HP restored separately. This expends **Resonant Patch**’s Scene use for each target. You must touch the first target normally or through **Borrowed Hands**.

talents.name: Return to the Bond
talents.description: When your personal construct or Workshop Wisp within Medium range fails to resist or end hostile technological control, reroll its Security Rating with one Bonus Die and use the new result. This includes a successful SR roll whose Success Tier was too low to resist. Compare the new result against the original opposing result; matching or exceeding its tier resists or ends the control.
talents.description_markdown: When your personal construct or **Workshop Wisp** within **Medium range** fails to resist or end hostile technological control, reroll its **Security Rating** with **one Bonus Die** and use the new result. This includes a successful SR roll whose **Success Tier** was too low to resist. Compare the new result against the original opposing result; matching or exceeding its tier resists or ends the control.

talents.name: Stand Behind Me
talents.description: Before an attack you perceive is rolled against an ally Engaged with your personal construct, have the construct intercept it. Both must be within Short range of you, and the construct must be a legal target able to physically interpose. Resolve the attack against the construct, using its normal defenses and Soak. This does not grant movement or intercept area attacks.

This does not grant movement or intercept area attacks.

talents.name: Aegis Engine
talents.description: Your personal construct projects a protective field for the rest of the Scene. Once per Round, while it is within Medium range, you may spend a Reaction when an attack you perceive damages the construct or a willing ally Engaged with it. Reduce that attack’s Physical or Veil damage by 1d6 + 2 after Soak, to a minimum of 0. Apply only the highest reduction if another magical damage reduction also applies. The field is inactive while the construct is Disabled.
talents.description_markdown: Your personal construct projects a protective field **for the rest of the Scene**. prerequisites.text: Stand Behind Me (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Cathedral of Scrap
talents.description: Gather nearby loose machinery and debris around your personal construct within Short range, enlarging it for the rest of the Scene. Its STR becomes 90, its Build increases by 2, and it reduces Physical damage by 2 after Soak. It gains Smash 60, an Engaged attack dealing 2d6 Physical damage, AP 2, with no Damage Bonus. Once on each of its turns, when Smash deals at least 1 HP of damage, it may also push a target of its Build or smaller up to Short range directly away. Obstacles stop the movement; falls and other hazards resolve normally. The transformation roughly doubles its height and width and requires sufficient space and loose material. It retains its normal command and Action limits.

talents.name: Living Workshop
talents.description: For the rest of the Scene, once on your turn you may spend a Maneuver to work through your Workshop Wisp within Medium range. Perform one nonattack Archanotech, Electronics, or Mechanics task that normally requires an Action, or use Resonant Patch, on something the Wisp can touch. Use your Skill and pay the task or talent’s normal costs and uses. This consumes the Wisp’s Action without a separate command Maneuver. Normal tools, materials, access, and opposed rolls still apply; longer tasks retain their normal duration.
talents.description_markdown: For the rest of the Scene, once on your turn you may spend a Maneuver to work through your **Workshop Wisp** within **Medium range**. Use your Skill and pay the task or talent’s normal costs and uses. This consumes the Wisp’s Action without a separate command Maneuver. talents.name: Masterwork Bond
talents.description: For the rest of the Scene, your personal construct gains one Bonus Die on attacks, technical Skill rolls, and Security Rating rolls against hostile technological interference while within Medium range of you. Once on each of its turns, after succeeding on an attack or technical Skill roll, it may also Assist an eligible ally without spending an Action. It must be positioned and capable of providing that assistance normally. These benefits are inactive while it is Disabled.

prerequisites.text: Instinctive Partnership or Return to the Bond (purchased in this career).

talents.name: Unbroken Creation
talents.description: Immediately after your personal construct or Workshop Wisp within Medium range takes damage you perceive, restore it to full HP. If HP loss was the only reason it was Disabled, it also restarts. Resolve this before any check for catastrophic destruction; it can prevent destruction even from overkill, provided the spirit’s core remains intact. This grants no additional Action and does not replace lost equipment, end hostile control, or remove other conditions.
